sentences.text: Can AI pick a random number?
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: We asked two models for a number from one to ten, thirty times each.
A fair pick lands on each number about three times.
Google's Flash-Lite said seven, thirty times out of thirty.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS said seven, thirty times.
A random pick would vary. This did not.
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: From one to a hundred, Google's Flash-Lite chose forty-two most often, twenty-six times.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS chose fifty-seven most often, twelve times.
People reportedly do it too: the blue-seven effect.
For a fair draw, use dice, or ask AI to write code.
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: Never let it pick your giveaway winner.
